name: PoYou
source:
Have you ever had that one person—a friend, perhaps someone more—who suddenly cut off contact, leaving only silence behind?

[From [url=https://bulhwa.itch.io/poyou]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾经遇到过这样一个人——一个朋友，或许更多的人——突然断绝了联系，只剩下沉默？

[来自[url=https://bulhwa.itch.io/poyou]itch.io[/url]]
